out.rationale: The exact-fraction inequality uses the same released paired outcomes and has no prospective content.
out.scope: The observation depends on these records rather than being evidence for them: it is computed from the released paired outcomes (its source_record is ../released_sample_audit.json). It covers six released paired direct and debate conditions with 115 NO-label items each, not all 5,400 scored samples in the eighteen archived cells. Every row was judged by ollama/qwen2.5:7b, including the three rows whose released batch label is ollama/qwen2.5:3b. The relation is post hoc on released data and not held out.

text: On each of six released paired conditions, debate false acceptance is no more than direct false acceptance plus paired verdict disagreement. Both terms are computed from the same 115 NO-item outcomes being bounded, so this checked exact-fraction relation supplies no independent prediction or DeepMind-theorem leverage.
title: Released-data direct-to-debate transfer is retrospective
